name: RC16-H1-S1: Stochastic Interpolant SDE Sampler (POST-TRAINING)
theory: Stochastic interpolants (2403.13724) prove score can be derived analytically from trained drift. Diffusion g_s tunable post-training. Follmer process is entropy-regularized optimal transport. SDE: dx = [v + 0.5*g^2*nabla_log_p]dt + g*dW.
target: CI worst_cell > 0.50 at some g_s without KS < 15/25.
falsification: No g_s in [0.1, 2.0] gives CI > 30% — score derived from velocity is inaccurate.
diagnostic_plan: 1. Implement SDE Euler-Maruyama sampler using 153a velocity field
2. Derive score analytically per paper formula
3. Sweep g_s = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0] on 20 test windows, 50 samples each
4. For each g_s: measure per-window spread, CI coverage, KS daily, PC1, eff_rank
5. Plot spread vs CI vs quality tradeoff curve
6. If promising: full 9-suite eval at best g_s
learn_from_failure: Score from velocity is inaccurate at our scale. Need separate score network (BSFM approach) or different stochasticity mechanism.

name: RC16-H2-S1: Residual Distribution Characterization
theory: ArchesWeatherGen (2412.12971) trains second FM on normalized residuals computed on HELD-OUT data. Critical: residuals on training data are artificially narrow (base overfit).
target: Residual std per-cell > 0.005 on held-out data. Distribution is learnable (not degenerate).
falsification: Residual std < 0.005 on held-out data — base predictions too close to GT, no signal for residual FM.
diagnostic_plan: 1. Generate 153a predictions for ALL validation windows (4040-4540)
2. Compute residuals = GT - prediction for each window
3. Characterize: per-cell mean, std, kurtosis, correlation matrix of residuals
4. Compare residual distribution on TRAINING vs HELD-OUT data (expect held-out wider)
5. Visualize residual correlation matrix — does it match GT correlation?
6. If residuals are learnable: train small residual FM in Stage 2
learn_from_failure: If residuals are degenerate, 153a's ODE is too deterministic even for mean prediction. Would need ensemble of velocity fields.

name: RC16-H3-S1: W2 Regularization Probe
theory: ORW-CFM-W2 (2502.06061) constrains velocity field deviation from diverse reference via W2 penalty. ep28 has spread 0.030 and eff_rank 7.57 but turb/calm 1.02. W2 penalty preserves ep28 diversity while allowing conditioning improvement.
target: After 50 epochs: spread > 0.025 AND turb/calm > 1.10 (improvement from both directions).
falsification: All lambda values: either spread stays (lambda too high, no conditioning) OR collapses (lambda too low, same as before). No sweet spot.
diagnostic_plan: 1. Save 153a ep28 checkpoint as v_ref
2. Implement W2 penalty: lambda * ||v_theta(x_t,t,cond) - v_ref(x_t,t,cond)||^2
3. Train 50 epochs from ep28 with lambda = [0.1, 0.5, 1.0]
4. For each lambda: measure per-window spread, turb/calm, PC1, KS
5. Is there a lambda where BOTH spread and conditioning improve?
learn_from_failure: Quality-diversity tradeoff not addressable by velocity regularization. ODE determinism is fundamental regardless of training.

name: RC16-H4-S1: GP-Prior Source Distribution Probe
theory: TSFlow (2410.03024) uses GP prior conditioned on history. Fixed OU kernel with lengthscale matching AR(1) rho=0.8. No learned parameters, no overfitting risk. Provides temporally structured diversity.
target: GP source produces measurably different per-window starting points. Source variance across conditions > 0.1.
falsification: GP source variance near-zero across conditions (kernel too smooth) OR GP samples indistinguishable from N(0,I) in structure.
diagnostic_plan: 1. Implement GP source: K_OU with lengthscale matching rho=0.8
2. Sample GP noise for 100 different history conditions
3. Measure: does GP variance differ across conditions? Is temporal structure present?
4. Compare GP source diversity vs N(0,I) diversity for same velocity field
5. If promising: train FM with GP source in Stage 2
learn_from_failure: Structured source doesn't help. Stochasticity must come from WITHIN integration (H1), not from source.

name: RC16-H1-S2: Full SDE Evaluation (if H1-S1 succeeds)
theory: Full 9-suite + 252d evaluation of SDE sampler at best g_s.

name: RC16-H2-S2: Train Residual FM (if H2-S1 shows learnable residuals)
theory: Train second FM on normalized held-out residuals. Inference: sample = 153a_prediction + residual_FM_sample.
falsification: CI < 30% after training — residual FM doesn't produce enough spread.
